data.title: A promise larger than the room
data.goal: Separate a workshop promise from an observable action and rewrite one claim.

memoryNodes.cue: Which two promises need to be rewritten?
memoryNodes.location: Beside the orange leaflet at the university screen.
memoryNodes.locationZh: 大学展示屏边，橙色传单旁。

memoryNodes.cue: What did the child actually change?
memoryNodes.location: At the paper, watching the child hold the pencil.
memoryNodes.locationZh: 纸张旁，观察孩子拿铅笔的位置。

memoryNodes.cue: What can the invitation honestly offer?
memoryNodes.cueZh: 邀请函可以诚实地提供什么？
memoryNodes.location: Beside the tablet and the rewritten invitation.
memoryNodes.locationZh: 平板和改写后的邀请函旁。

data.situation: The orange leaflet clipped beside the university screen caught Lin's eye. A Saturday workshop promised to "develop inborn potentials" and help every child "master cutting-edge technology" in one hour. Lin took the leaflet and followed the arrow into a room with pencils, paper and one tablet. The room looked welcoming, but the promises seemed too large for a short visit. She put the leaflet beside a blank sheet and watched the first activity. A child was drawing a bridge. His first line bent to one side. He adjusted his grip, pressed more lightly and tried again. These were motor skills in use: small, controlled movements of his hand. Lin could describe the action without claiming that it revealed his future. A volunteer offered guidance on a simple drawing tool. Lin crossed out the second promise and wrote, "Children can try a digital tool with guidance." The child lifted his new drawing; it was an example of what he had done today.
data.zhSupport: 先看传单许诺什么，再看孩子实际做了什么。两句原资料广告用语供识别与批改，不作为主动输出目标。

glossary.zh: 发掘先天潜能（此处是待质疑的宣传承诺）
glossary.note: Source-derived 原词项完整保留。这里只是对传单用语的引用，不能从一小时活动推断先天潜能已被开发；不推荐作为套句输出。

glossary.zh: 掌握前沿技术（此处是待修改的宣传承诺）
glossary.note: Source-derived 原词项完整保留。master 的承诺强于 try；本故事的一小时体验不能支持人人掌握前沿技术。请练习改写，而不是照搬。
motor skills 指控制身体运动的技能；本句观察握笔和力度，不证明技能已因这次活动而提高。
adjust the grip 可描述可见动作；his 在此指这个孩子。

glossary.text: try a digital tool with guidance
glossary.zh: 在指导下尝试一个数字工具
glossary.note: try 的范围小于 master；with guidance 交代条件。
本课观察手部动作控制：握笔、调整力度、画线。motor skills是复数名词块；源例句中的fine更具体指小肌肉动作，不把所有运动技能都限为手部。观察运用不证明一次活动已提高技能。

glossary.zh: 幅度小且受到控制的动作
glossary.note: 本课描述孩子手部动作，而非对智力作判断。controlled修饰movements，表示动作得到控制；可与握笔和力度这两个可见细节一起说明。
with + guidance说明开展活动时有建议或帮助。guidance通常不可数；这里来自志愿者，不表示单靠提供帮助就保证学习结果。

glossary.zh: 表达依赖条件的可能性
glossary.note: may后接动词原形，if后说明尚须满足的条件。这里给家长一个有限看法；可能获益不等于已经证明有效。
matchTexts: A short workshop may be useful if guidance is available.
A short workshop may give children a chance to try a digital tool if guidance is available.

retrievalPrompts.cue: The leaflet promises that every child will master a new technology in one hour. Replace it with an offer the room can support.
acceptableAnswers: Children can try a digital tool with guidance.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Name the activity and the support; do not promise mastery.
retrievalPrompts.draft: Every child will master cutting-edge technology in one hour.
targetTerms: try a digital tool with guidance
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 传单说每个孩子一小时就能熟练掌握新技术。请根据房间实际提供的工具与帮助，把这句宣传改成诚实的邀请。
checks: 写清可以做的体验活动。
交代有人指导这一条件。
不承诺所有孩子都会达到熟练掌握。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 把看得见的活动和能提供的帮助写清楚；熟练掌握需要更多依据。

retrievalPrompts.cue: The child changes how he holds the pencil and presses more lightly. Describe this as an observation.
acceptableAnswers: The child adjusted his grip and used small, controlled movements. These are motor skills in use.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Describe what happened. One drawing does not establish improvement or reveal a child's future.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 孩子改变握笔方式，落笔力度也更轻。请描述这个可见动作，并说明在运用哪类技能。
checks: 描述握笔或力度的具体变化。
把手部动作联系到身体动作控制。
不从一次画画推断技能已经提高或孩子未来怎样。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 先说实际观察到的动作。技能在被运用，与技能已提高是不同的判断。

retrievalPrompts.function: Give a limited opinion with a condition
retrievalPrompts.cue: A family asks whether a short workshop is worth trying. Give one modest view that depends on guidance.
acceptableAnswers: A short workshop may give children a chance to try a digital tool if guidance is available.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: May and if limit the claim. You are offering a possible benefit, not a proven result.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 家长问短工作坊值不值得试。请给一个适度看法，并说明它依赖什么帮助条件。
checks: 说明需要可获得的指导。
理由围绕一次工具体验，不保证长期成果。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 看法、活动与条件连起来；用限定性表达给家长留出判断空间。

transferPrompt.function: Transfer one opinion and one reason
transferPrompt.cue: A library offers a short craft session with a volunteer. Give one opinion and a reason based on an activity you could see.
acceptableAnswers: The session may be useful if guidance is available, because children can try drawing and practise motor skills.
transferPrompt.feedback: Use a new setting. Connect a limited opinion to a specific activity rather than a promise about intelligence.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 图书馆安排了一次有志愿者帮助的手工活动。请给一个有限看法，再用你可能看见的活动说明理由。
checks: 给出具体活动，如绘画及手部动作练习。
不保证智力或长期能力变化。
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 迁移的是具体活动、帮助条件和有限观点；无需重复传单承诺。

data.easySummary: The leaflet makes two large promises for a one-hour workshop. Lin watches a child change his grip and draw again. A volunteer helps the child try a tool. Lin rewrites the invitation to name this activity and the guidance available.
data.easySummaryZh: 传单对一小时工作坊作了两个很大的承诺。林看见孩子调整握笔姿势，再画一次。志愿者帮助孩子尝试工具。林改写邀请函，写明活动与可获得的指导。
